effect.name: GM Spectral Aberration
effect.desc: Lens-space RGB dispersion with radial falloff and independent strength.
effect.shader: void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm;vec2 screenSize=max(acScreenSize,vec2(1.0));vec2 c=(acLayerCenter+center)/screenSize;vec2 d=uv-c;float dist=length(d);float radial=pow(max(dist,0.00001),max(falloff,0.00001));vec2 dir=d/max(dist,0.00001);vec2 o=dir*amount*radial;vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);vec4 redSample=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+o,0.0,1.0));vec4 blueSample=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv-o,0.0,1.0));gl_FragColor=vec4(redSample.r,src.g,blueSample.b,src.a);}
